Estimate per-image marker thresholds

Source: R/thresholds.R
gk_thresholds.Rd

Estimates thresholds for identity and conditional identity markers. Support is checked before estimation, and every method records a status rather than inventing a cut when its input is absent, underpowered or not separated. State-marker thresholds are estimated by gk_state_calls() after parent labels are available.

Usage

gk_thresholds(
  prepared,
  config,
  embedding = NULL,
  correction = NULL,
  seed = 5420L
)

Arguments

prepared

A gk_prepare() result.

config

The configuration used to prepare the data.

embedding

An optional gk_embed() result for population_crossing.

correction

NULL or a gk_correct() result.

seed

Seed used when sampling embedding populations.

Value

An object of class gk_thresholds, a data frame with one row per image and marker, the threshold result columns, and an evidence attribute containing density and pool data for plotting.

See also

Other thresholds: gk_embed(), gk_threshold_methods()

Examples

prep <- gk_prepare(gk_example_path("example-slide"), gk_example_config(), quiet = TRUE)
thresholds <- gk_thresholds(prep, gk_example_config(), seed = 1L)
thresholds[, c("marker", "status", "estimate")]
#> <gk_thresholds>: 9 image x marker results
#> • Statuses: "CALLABLE = 8; NOT_CALLABLE_ABSENT = 1"
#> • Evidence records: 0
